Degrees

Oct, 2018 — May, 2022

Institute for Theoretical Physics (LUH), Hannover

I received my PhD in Theoretical Physics from LUH under the supervision of Olaf Lechtenfeld with generous support from DAAD. My thesis “Solutions of Yang–Mills theory in 4 dimensional de Sitter space” is based on classical gauge theory.

Jul, 2015 — May, 2018

Indian Institute of Science Education & Research, Kolkata

I graduated from IISER-K with a Masters degree in Physics of the Integrated PhD programme. This 3-year intensive training proved greatly beneficial with regular and niche course-work in Physics and Mathematics, as well as many other useful skills.

Jul, 2010 — May, 2015

Indian Institute of Technology (BHU), Varanasi

I hold Bachelor and Master of Technology degrees from a 5-year programme in the Biochemical Engineering school at IIT-BHU. Alongside, I kept nurturing my theoretical physics interests through mostly self-directed learning.

Teaching

Institute for Theoretical Physics, Leibniz University Hannover

  1. At the end of summer semester 2020 I conducted an intensive revision course (lectures + exercises) on Introduction to Quantum Theory.

  2. I conducted an intensive 1-week revision course (lectures + exercises) on Mathematical Methods of Physics at the end of winter semester 2019–20.

  3. I assisted (exercises + 2 lectures) the Lie Groups, Algebra and their Representations course by my supervisor, Olaf Lechtenfeld, during summer semester 2019.

Indian Institute of Science Education & Research, Kolkata

  1. I assisted (assignments) the Advanced Mathematical Methods of Physics course by Sunandan Gangopadhyay during autumn semester 2017.

  2. I assisted (exercises + assignments) the Intermediate Electricity and Magnetism course by Ananda Dasgupta during spring semester 2017.

Scholarships

I am truly grateful to the following scholarships and fellowships for facilitating my academic journey!

I currently hold the DFG Walter-Benjamin research grant to work on “Particle physics from Quantum Riemannian Geometry” at QMUL London, with Shahn Majid. More details on the project scope can be found here.

I was a recipient of the doctoral fellowship programme by the Deutscher Akademischer Austauschdienst (DAAD) in 2018, which funded my PhD in Hannover following a German-learning stint in Berlin.

In 2016, I secured the Junior Research Fellowship of the Council for Scientific & Industrial Research (CSIR) after qualifying the national eligibility test (NET), which funded me during Oct, 2016 – May, 2018 at IISER-K.

I was part of the Super-30 programme (intensive IIT-JEE preparation) in 2009–10. Its founder, Anand Kumar, is a mathematician with remarkable teaching skills and is very well known.

I was at JNV, Ranchi during 2008–09, participating in a programme organised by the Dakshana Foundation (a non-profit). My fascination for science—especially physics—started there.
